query: UPDATE envelopes SET status = $4, version = version + 1, sent_at = CASE WHEN $4 = 'sent' THEN $5 ELSE sent_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN $4 = 'completed' THEN $5 ELSE completed_at END, voided_at = CASE WHEN $4 = 'voided' THEN $5 ELSE voided_at END, void_reason = CASE WHEN $4 = 'voided' THEN $6 ELSE void_reason END WHERE account_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $3 RETURNING version
